slides.title: What is TAK?
slides.html:
• TAK is the US DoD's situational awareness ecosystem of choice.
  • ATAK for Android is the main client, but there are clients for all platforms, like iOS and Windows.
  • As TAK is by its main parts open source, we can utilize it sovereignly to a large extent.

slides.title: Intro: what you can do with TAK
slides.html:
• TAK is a tremendously capable tool.
  • Mostly your benefits from TAK are limited by your user's skill to work with it.
  • The OpenDefence guide attempts to help you a bit with this.

slides.title: Blue-force Tracking
slides.html:
With TAK, you can do Blue-force Tracking out of the box.

  • This means seeing where you are and where your teammates are on the map.
  • This allows leaders to make better decision with proper real time information.

slides.title: Placing and sharing Markers
slides.html:
TAK lets you place and manage markers to build an awareness picture on the map.

  • Place markers to map (Enemies, Friendlies, Other: Hospitals, Supply Points, etc)
  • Send the markers to users and groups.
  • OpenDefence standard model instructed later offers a simple way to ensure your unit uses the marker feature potently.

slides.title: Data Sync
slides.html:
TAK lets you syncronize data from your TAK Server without manual effort.

  • Synchronize chat, map markers, files between users and server.
  • Data is shown while offline, changes can be made and automatically updated when online.

slides.title: Planning
slides.html:
TAK lets you draw and share georeferenced plans for your troops.

  • Plans for eg. unit placements, movements and Areas of Responsibility & Operation.
  • Plans can be prepared beforehand and shared to users when needed.

slides.title: Chat features
slides.html:
TAK contains rudimentary chat features out of the box.

  • Message other users and groups via TAK.
  • Send text, pictures, files and datapackages.
  • Use the TAK Geochat if your unit does not use more advantaged tools like the Matrix.

slides.title: You need a Server
slides.html:
• To gain these benefits from TAK you need a Server. Deploy App's TAK provides you one with state-of-the-art easy access.
  • TAK client apps connected to the Server automatically post their location to server.
  • With a server access, you can easily share and receive data such as situational awareness products made by your CP as TAK Feeds.

slides.title: Deploy App automates Server management
slides.html:
With Deploy App, you never have to configure your TAK Server manually.

  • A Deploy App instance brings up a bundled official-flavor TAK Server.
  • You and your fighters can access it with two taps from Deploy App.

We believe soldiers should operate, not to rub servers. Deploy App removes manual config with a highly secure execution.
